title: [Cuiru Keli Improves Postpartum Hypogalactia in Rats Through Secreted Frizzled-Related Protein 2-Wnt/beta-catenin Signaling Pathway].
authors: Xue, Qiuyun; Huang, Yurong; Li, Hui; Li, Chen; Cheng, Chenglong; Wang, Yuting; Miao, Chenggui
journal: Sichuan da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Sichuan University. Medical science edition
one_liner_zh: 该文研究催乳颗粒通过SFRP2-Wnt/β-catenin通路治疗产后缺乳，属动物药理实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Based on the secreted frizzled-related protein 2 (SFRP2)-Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, this study explored the effect and mechanism of Cuiru Keli (CRKL) in the treatment of postpartum hypogalactia. METHODS: A rat model of postpartum hypogalactia was established by gavaging 2 mL of 1.6 mg/mL bromocriptine mesylate to female rats on the third day after delivery. Female rats with a delivery time difference of less than 48 hours were selected and randomly assigned to 7 groups, including a normal group (without any modeling or medication), a model group, a CRKL low-dose group of model group model rats receiving CRKL at the dose of 3 g/kg, a CRKL medium-dose group of model rats receiving CRKL at the dose of 6 g/kg, a CRKL high-dose group of model rats receiving CRKL at the dose of 9 g/kg, a positive drug group of model rats receiving domperidone at the dose of 3 mg/kg, and a negative control (NC) group of model rats receiving normal saline. Each group contained 6 rats. Except for the normal and model groups, the remaining 5 groups were continuously administered with the respective intervention drugs at the specified doses by gavage once a day for 10 days. Changes in the total litter mass of the offspring in the 7 groups within 10 days were measured, and HE staining was performed to identify pathological changes in the mammary tissue (MT). Six groups of rats (excluding the positive control group) were used to observe the pathological changes of eosinophils in pituitary tissue. ELISA was performed to determine the content of prolactin (PRL) in serum, immunohistochemical staining was used to determine the expression of prolactin receptor (PRLR) in MT, and RT-qPCR was used to determine the mRNA expression of genes related to lactation in MT. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to study the therapeutic effect and mechanism of CRKL on postpartum hypogalactia, particularly whether it acted through the SFRP2-Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. The mechanism of CRKL treatment was further validated by detecting mRNA (RT-qPCR) and protein expression (Western blot) of related pathway genes. Cell experiments were conducted using primary culture rat mammary epithelial cells (RMEC) from rat MT. RMEC were divided into four groups, including a normal group (primary culture RMEC, untreated), SFRP2 overexpression group (primary cultured RMEC treated with SFRP2 overexpression vector), SFRP2 overexpression+CRKL group (receiving treatment for SFRP2 overexpression group plus 10% drug-containing serum), and negative control group (primary culture RMEC treated with empty vector). The effect of CRKL on the expression of lactation-related genes FASN, CSN2, and GLUT1 mRNA after SFRP2 overexpression was detected by RT-qPCR. RESULTS: In this study, CRKL was administered at a dose of 3 g/kg in the CRKL low-dose group, 6 g/kg in the medium-dose group, and 9 g/kg in the high-dose group (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Compared with the model group, CRKL at all doses significantly increased the total litter weight gain of the offsprings within 10 days (P<0.05 or P<0.01), and effectively increased lactation (P<0.01), the area of mammary lobules, and the size and filling of acinar cavities. CRKL at all doses also increased the number of eosinophils that secreted PRL in the pituitary gland of the postpartum hypogalactia rat model, and increased the content of PRL in the serum (P<0.05 or P<0.01). CRKL promoted the secretion and expression of PRL in postpartum hypogalactic model rats. In addition, it significantly promoted the expression of genes related to milk fat, milk protein, and lactose synthesis in MT (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Network pharmacology predicted that the Wnt signaling pathway might be a key pathway for CRKL in treating postpartum hypogalactia. The molecular docking results showed that related chemical components in CRKL had good binding ability with CCND1 and SFRP2. Compared with the model group, CRKL at all doses inhibited the expression of SFRP2 gene in vivo (P<0.01) and activated the mRNA and protein expression of CCND1 and c-Myc in the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway in MT (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Cell experiments showed that, compared to the normal group, SFRP2 overexpression reduced the mRNA expression of milk synthesis-related genes FASN, CSN2, and GLUT1 in RMEC (P<0.01). The CCK8 results indicated that 10% of the drug-containing serum was the effective concentration administered to cells (P<0.01). After administering drug-containing serum, the expression of the lactation-related genes FASN, CSN2, and GLUT1 were up-regulated (compared with the SFRP2 overexpression group, P<0.01). CONCLUSION: CRKL alleviates postpartum hypogalactia through the SFRP2-Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. SFRP2 might be a potential new target for the diagnosis and treatment of postpartum hypogalactia. This reveals a new mechanism of CRKL in treating postpartum hypogalactia and promotes its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 目的：基于分泌型卷曲相关蛋白2（SFRP2）-Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，探讨催乳颗粒（CRKL）治疗产后缺乳的作用及机制。方法：于产后第3天，通过灌胃2 mL 1.6 mg/mL甲磺酸溴隐亭给雌性大鼠，建立产后缺乳大鼠模型。选取分娩时间差小于48小时的雌性大鼠，随机分为7组，包括正常组（不进行任何造模或给药）、模型组、CRKL低剂量组（模型大鼠接受3 g/kg CRKL）、CRKL中剂量组（模型大鼠接受6 g/kg CRKL）、CRKL高剂量组（模型大鼠接受9 g/kg CRKL）、阳性药物组（模型大鼠接受3 mg/kg多潘立酮）和阴性对照（NC）组（模型大鼠接受生理盐水）。每组6只大鼠。除正常组和模型组外，其余5组每天按指定剂量灌胃给予相应干预药物，连续10天。测量7组子代在10天内的总窝重变化，并通过HE染色观察乳腺组织（MT）的病理变化。使用6组大鼠（不包括阳性对照组）观察垂体组织中嗜酸性粒细胞的病理变化。采用ELISA测定血清中催乳素（PRL）含量，免疫组织化学染色测定MT中催乳素受体（PRLR）的表达，RT-qPCR测定MT中泌乳相关基因的mRNA表达。通过网络药理学和分子对接研究CRKL对产后缺乳的治疗作用及机制，特别是是否通过SFRP2-Wnt/β-catenin信号通路发挥作用。通过检测相关通路基因的mRNA（RT-qPCR）和蛋白表达（Western blot）进一步验证CRKL治疗的机制。细胞实验使用大鼠MT原代培养的大鼠乳腺上皮细胞（RMEC）。RMEC分为四组，包括正常组（原代培养RMEC，未处理）、SFRP2过表达组（用SFRP2过表达载体处理的原代培养RMEC）、SFRP2过表达+CRKL组（SFRP2过表达组处理加10%含药血清）和阴性对照组（用空载体处理的原代培养RMEC）。通过RT-qPCR检测SFRP2过表达后CRKL对泌乳相关基因FASN、CSN2和GLUT1 mRNA表达的影响。结果：本研究中，CRKL在低剂量组以3 g/kg给药，中剂量组以6 g/kg给药，高剂量组以9 g/kg给药（P<0.05或P<0.01）。与模型组相比，各剂量CRKL均显著增加子代在10天内的总窝重增长（P<0.05或P<0.01），并有效增加泌乳量（P<0.01）、乳腺小叶面积以及腺泡腔的大小和充盈度。各剂量CRKL还增加了产后缺乳大鼠模型中垂体分泌PRL的嗜酸性粒细胞数量，并增加了血清中PRL含量（P<0.05或P<0.01）。CRKL促进了产后缺乳模型大鼠中PRL的分泌和表达。此外，它显著促进了MT中乳脂、乳蛋白和乳糖合成相关基因的表达（P<0.05或P<0.01）。网络药理学预测Wnt信号通路可能是CRKL治疗产后缺乳的关键通路。分子对接结果显示，CRKL中的相关化学成分与CCND1和SFRP2具有良好的结合能力。与模型组相比，各剂量CRKL在体内抑制了SFRP2基因的表达（P<0.01），并激活了MT中Wnt/β-catenin信号通路中CCND1和c-Myc的mRNA和蛋白表达（P<0.05或P<0.01）。细胞实验显示，与正常组相比，SFRP2过表达降低了RMEC中乳合成相关基因FASN、CSN2和GLUT1的mRNA表达（P<0.01）。CCK8结果表明，10%含药血清是给药细胞的有效浓度（P<0.01）。给予含药血清后，泌乳相关基因FASN、CSN2和GLUT1的表达上调（与SFRP2过表达组相比，P<0.01）。结论：CRKL通过SFRP2-Wnt/β-catenin信号通路缓解产后缺乳。SFRP2可能是产后缺乳诊断和治疗的一个潜在新靶点。这揭示了CRKL治疗产后缺乳的新机制，并促进了其临床应用。
